description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerReviewerDecorator class, which is a decorator for handling performance tracker reviewer entities in the HR management system. It includes a trait for managing entity references and provides a method to set a reviewer by employee number.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerReviewerDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that encapsulates logic for managing PerformanceTrackerReviewer entities, providing additional methods and integrating entity management traits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a PerformanceTrackerReviewer entity.

methods.name: setReviewerByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the reviewer for the performance tracker using an employee's number by fetching the Employee entity reference.
